description: Classic P2P file sharing and chat client (Frontcode, 2005) for the WinMX Peer Network, with the WinMX Community Patch 1.0 that reconnects it.
notes: Not portable and not silent: this runs the community setup (WinMX 3.54 Beta 4 + Community Patch 1.0)
in its own wizard; finish it yourself. Install and uninstall from an elevated (admin) shell.
WinMX is abandoned since 2005; the network is kept alive by its users. The patch replaces
OLEDLG.DLL in the WinMX folder so that WinMX connects to the community caches instead of the old
Frontcode servers. Antivirus programs may flag that DLL for the same reason.
Settings and the shared library (*.dat) live in the WinMX folder chosen in the wizard.
Only 'scoop uninstall WinMX' removes WinMX from the system; it opens WinMX's own uninstaller.
A fresh install stops if WinMX Community Patch is already installed without Scoop. To let Scoop take over
that copy, run $env:GESU_ALLOW_EXISTING = '1' in the same shell and install again.
pre_install: if (!(is_admin)) { error "$app setup writes to Program Files and HKLM: run this from an elevated shell."; break }
# A fresh 'scoop install' must not silently take over a copy installed without Scoop.

error "$($existing.DisplayName) is already installed on this system. Uninstall it first, or run `$env:GESU_ALLOW_EXISTING = '1' and install again to let Scoop install over it and manage it from now on."

script: Write-Host 'Finish the WinMX setup wizard that opens now.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
if ($setup.ExitCode -ne 0) { error "WinMX setup exited with code $($setup.ExitCode)."; break }
if (!(is_admin)) { error "$app was installed into Program Files and HKLM: run this from an elevated shell."; break }
if (!$entry) { warn 'WinMX Community Patch was not found among installed programs; nothing to remove.'; return }
Write-Host 'Finish the WinMX uninstaller that opens now.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
